heroSubtitle: Terra Preta Organics develops soil amendments that restore soil function on degraded reclamation sites across Canada.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Terra Preta is the industrial evolution of Doug Gardens, founded by Stephanie and Lee Martineau. After proving the power of biologically active soil systems in urban gardens and small-scale agriculture, the next step was clear: bring those same principles to the industries that disturb land at scale.

Oil and gas, mining, and agriculture all face the same reality. Compacted, stripped, and depleted soils cannot recover with surface-level inputs alone. They require biology, organic matter, structure, and the capacity to rebuild themselves.

Terra Preta was formed to meet that need.

Built on the same regenerative soil philosophy that shaped Doug Gardens, Terra Preta delivers high-performance biological soil solutions specifically designed for large-scale reclamation and agricultural applications. Our products are engineered to restore function, improve water-holding capacity, accelerate establishment, and support long-term land resilience.

From well sites to mine reclamation to broad-acre farmland, Terra Preta exists to help land recover faster and perform longer.

We believe reclamation should not just meet standards. It should restore living systems.

items.title: Manufacturing in Sundre, Alberta
items.description: Our facility in Sundre produces Terra Revive pellets using consistent formulations and quality-controlled processes. We maintain inventory to support Canada-wide delivery.

items.title: Quality assurance
items.description: Every batch is tested for moisture content, particle size, and ingredient consistency. We provide batch-specific QA documentation and maintain traceability for all shipments.

members.name: Lee Martineau
members.description: Lee Martineau is the Founder and CEO of Terra Preta Organics and a recognized leader in regenerative soil reclamation. He develops advanced, biology-driven pelletized amendments that restore soil function on disturbed landscapes, with a focus on rebuilding organic matter, activating nutrient cycling, and strengthening long-term ecosystem resilience. Working closely with environmental and energy sector partners, Lee brings a systems-based approach to reclamation that integrates soil biology, mineral balance, and practical field application to improve measurable site performance.

members.name: Chris Kay
members.description: Chris grew up on a farm in Alberta and now works with homesteaders and farmers to design and develop thriving properties that align with their vision and values. As part of the Terra Preta team, he approaches soil from first principles and hands-on experience, prioritizing long-term land function over short-term inputs.
